description:
What a site runs on: CMS, ecommerce platform, analytics, JavaScript frameworks, CDN, servers and hosting (Vercel, Netlify, Heroku…). A workspace site's stack is cached on it; any other domain (a competitor) works too.

Billing: free. A workspace site's stack under 7 days old is served from its profile (detected_at); older ones are re-detected. Other domains: 50 new lookups a day per workspace, cached 24 h.

When to call: before writing fix instructions, to tailor them to the platform (WordPress vs Shopify vs Webflow vs a custom Next.js app).

Returns { site_id (null for a non-workspace domain), domain, detected_at, detected_cms, is_wordpress, technologies: { cms, ecommerce, analytics, javascript, cdn, servers, hosting }, all, note? }, or detected: false when the index has no data. Errors: provider_unavailable (retry), rate_limited. From DataForSEO's index, which can lag a recent platform change.

domain.description: Any domain, e.g. a competitor's ("acme.com"). A workspace site's domain reads and caches like site_id.

site_id.description: A workspace site (site_id from list_sites); its stack is cached on it. Or pass domain.

name: detect_tech_stack
title: Detect a site's CMS / platform / tech stack
